decision: Supersedes the pick row: Gemini did build. All three candidates compiled with no warnings.

decision: Save and discard clear lap count, lap time, and max speed before returning to ready.
why: Opus tests found the ready screen kept the previous ride's lap count. Our acceptConfirm nulled the session and left _laps set.

decision: START stays on the press-type contract. A 500 ms hold timer was not added.
why: Fable measured the simulator delivering PRESS_TYPE_ACTION on every START down, and worked around it with a timer. The device API uses ACTION for the long press. The ride in the screenshots was started with the screen tap, which calls onSelect.
